name: data-database-treesave-runtime

args: Database.NestedSaveResult objectResult = Database.treeSave(new Account(Name = 'Tree Runtime Object')); System.assert(objectResult.isSuccess()); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Tree Runtime Parent'); account.put('Contacts', new List<Contact>{new Contact(LastName = 'Child')}); List<Database.NestedSaveResult> results = Database.treeSave(new List<Account>{account}); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); Database.NestedSaveResult result = results[0]; System.assert(result.isSuccess()); System.assert(result.getId() != null); System.assertEquals(0, result.getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals(result.getRelationshipSaveResults(), result.relationshipsaveresults); System.assert(result.toString() != null); System.assert(result.hashCode() != null); System.assert(result.equals(result)); System.assertEquals(1, result.getRelationshipSaveResults().size()); Database.RelationshipSaveResult relationship = result.getRelationshipSaveResults()[0]; System.assertEquals('Contacts', relationship.getRelationshipName()); System.assertEquals(relationship.getRelationshipName(), relationship.relationshipname); System.assertEquals(1, relationship.getSaveResults().size()); System.assertEquals(relationship.getSaveResults(), relationship.saveresults); System.assert(relationship.toString() != null); System.assert(relationship.hashCode() != null); System.assert(relationship.equals(relationship)); Database.NestedSaveResult emptyResult = new Database.NestedSaveResult(); Database.RelationshipSaveResult emptyRelationship = new Database.RelationshipSaveResult(); System.assert(emptyResult != null); System.assert(emptyRelationship != null);
